responseMessageContents.text:
**No — I do not acknowledge it as 10/10 right now.**

Current honest rating: **strong developer tooling, but incomplete autonomous reliability.**

It still has critical unresolved proof gaps:
- Latest GitHub release has a build-blocking malformed SES source.
- Production is running a different, older commit than GitHub `main`.
- The corrected source has not yet been committed and deployed.
- Physical-device QA and real email-delivery verification remain incomplete.

It can only be rated 10/10 after a successful new deployment and verified GitHub-to-production SHA match, plus the remaining reliability gates.
